one_liner: Run a full pretrain pipeline end-to-end, raw corpus to sampled checkpoint, at four hardware scales.

key_terms.definition: The on-disk contract: tokenized corpora are written as raw uint16 integers in fixed-size .bin shards, which the training loader memory-maps directly; writer and loader dtypes must match exactly.
Rounding GPT-2's 50257-token vocabulary up to 50304 so the embedding/lm_head matmul and softmax align to GPU tensor-core tile sizes, at zero cost to model quality.
The training-loop component (built in chapter 3.5) that memmaps uint16 .bin shards and slices out fixed-length (ctx+1)-token windows for each training batch.
The optimizer used throughout (betas 0.9/0.95, weight_decay 0.1), which decays only 2-D weight matrices and excludes 1-D biases/norm gains from decay.
The learning-rate schedule (`lr_at`) that ramps linearly from 0 to a peak LR over a warmup window, then decays it following a cosine curve down to a floor min_lr.
Running several forward/backward micro-batches (scaled by 1/grad_accum) before a single optimizer step, letting an effective batch size exceed what fits in memory on one GPU.
A Fully Sharded Data Parallel strategy that shards model parameters, gradients, and optimizer state across all ranks, used for the 8-GPU and multi-node scales in this chapter.
An FSDP variant that fully shards parameters within a fast-NVLink node but replicates the model across nodes, trading some memory for cheaper cross-node communication.
The fraction of a GPU's peak FLOP/s actually delivered during training, computed from the 6N-per-token FLOP rule and tokens/sec; ~40-55% is the healthy range at GPU scale.
exp of the mean cross-entropy loss on held-out data, interpreted as the effective branching factor of the model's next-token distribution; lower is better.
The global gradient norm measured before clipping is applied; logged (not the post-clip value, which is artificially bounded) as the signal that reveals instability spikes.
Training in the bfloat16 numeric format rather than fp16, chosen because its wider dynamic range avoids the silent overflow-to-NaN failure mode fp16 exhibits during training.
